clips.title: The story
paras: At Misty Pine Refuge, the Argent Dawn keeps a small outpost in central Dun Morogh.

Misty Pine Refuge is an unassuming Argent Dawn outpost among Dun Morogh's windswept hills. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the surrounding crags, while Father Gavin, the order's lone agent here, keeps a quiet hearth amid the bitter cold and dangers of the mountain roads.
